取视频信息、下载视频/音频、抓字幕文本（基于 yt-dlp）: Fetch video information, download video or audio, and extract subtitle text with yt-dlp
只读元数据，不下载。用来在下载前判断时长/体积，或只需要标题与简介时。: Read metadata without downloading. Check duration and size before downloading, or retrieve the title and description.
视频页地址或 11 位 video id: Video page URL or 11-character video ID
上游没给时为 0: Zero when the upstream service does not provide a size
下载后把文件交回平台，画布里流转的是文件引用。**这是重活**：默认超时 15: Download and upload a platform file reference. This operation can be expensive: the default timeout is 15 minutes, with limits of 720p and 512 MB to avoid filling disk space with large videos.
填了就忽略「清晰度」，直接下 video_info 列出的那个 format_i: Overrides resolution with a format_id returned by video_info. Select an existing upstream stream from the available formats.
超过就**不下载**、直接报错——比下到一半失败可读得多。**填 0 = 不限*: Reject before downloading when the estimated size exceeds the limit. Set 0 for no limit. Disk space and the operation timeout still apply; unrestricted downloads can fill the container disk.
留空则用视频标题: Leave blank to use the video title
高清视频在上游是「视频轨 + 音频轨」两条流，取回来要用 ffmpeg 合并成一: High-resolution video and audio often arrive as separate streams. ffmpeg merges them without re-encoding. Lower resolutions may already contain both in one file.
只取音频轨。**默认不转码**——上游的音频本来就是独立的一条流，原样拿下来最快: Download only the audio stream. Source mode avoids re-encoding and preserves quality. Selecting mp3, m4a or opus may run a slower, lossy ffmpeg conversion.
只在转码时有意义；原样下载时上游给多少就是多少。: Only applies when converting. Source mode preserves the upstream bitrate.
填 0 = 不限。音频通常只有视频的十分之一，很少撞上: Set 0 for no limit. Audio is usually much smaller than video.
true = 经 ffmpeg 重新编码（有损）；false = 上游原始音频轨: True when ffmpeg re-encoded the audio; false when the original upstream audio stream was preserved.
取字幕并转成纯文本（去时间轴、去重复行）。优先人工字幕，没有就用自动生成的。 不: Fetch subtitles as plain text, removing timestamps and repeated lines. Prefer manual subtitles, then automatic captions. Does not download video or require speech transcription.
按 BCP-47 前缀匹配，如 zh / zh-Hans / en；没有该语言时: Match BCP-47 language prefixes such as zh, zh-Hans or en. Fall back to the first available track when the requested language is unavailable.
自动字幕有错字，用于摘要可以，用于引用要核对: Automatic captions can contain errors. Verify the text before quoting it.
平台约定的保留 id。这里没有凭证，检的是 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg 在不: Checks the local tools and outbound network. This plugin does not require a platform credential.
